scope: Seven high-risk proposed target-field edits, read in the full contexts of six canonical Japanese mock questions. Not full-locale review or third-party PDF verification.

reviews.canonicalText: 総数20件、上位二分類は18件なので18/20×100=90%。安全上重大な少数分類は別途評価する。
reviews.before: Tổng 20, hai nhóm 18: 90%; lỗi ít nghiêm trọng an toàn đánh giá riêng.
reviews.proposedAfter: Tổng cộng 20 trường hợp; hai nhóm đứng đầu có 18 trường hợp nên 18/20 × 100 = 90%. Những nhóm có ít trường hợp nhưng mức độ nghiêm trọng cao về an toàn vẫn phải được đánh giá riêng.
assertions: 12+6+2=20 total; top two count18; cumulative percentage18/20×100=90.
少数分類 means a category with relatively few occurrences, not a low-severity safety defect.
Proposed Vietnamese expressly says low occurrence count but high safety severity still requires separate evaluation; this preserves the source safety caveat.

reviews.proposedAfter: 4 लाई 80 ले भाग गर्दा 0.05 अर्थात् 5% हुन्छ; 10% होइन।
assertions: Sample denominator remains80,not lot800:4÷80=0.05, equivalent to5%.
Final Nepali wording explicitly states division by80 gives0.05,that is5%,not10%; it retains canonical meaning without presenting a fraction-to-percentage equality as an arithmetic error.
The original4÷80=5% is mathematically valid; final proposal now correctly classifies the issue as a compressed percent explanation.
metadataQualifications: Earlier metadata overclaim resolved: final issue overcompressed_percent_calculation,severitymedium,andreason explicitly recognise original identity is mathematically valid.

reviews.canonicalText: 基本オンディレーは入力オンが設定時間続いてから出力する。機種の保持機能等は別に確認する。
reviews.before: Basic input must continue 5 s; hiwalay ang retention ng modelo.
reviews.proposedAfter: Sa isang karaniwang on-delay, kailangang manatiling naka-on ang input sa buong itinakdang oras bago mag-on ang output. Hiwalay na suriin sa dokumentasyon ng modelo ang mga retention function nito.
assertions: Canonical input is on for3s with5s on-delay; correct option1 says no output-on before the setting is reached.
Proposed Filipino states input must remain on for the entire setting before output turns on; this preserves the input/output causal sequence.
Model-specific retention features are separately checked, not asserted as a universal timer guarantee.

reviews.canonicalText: 6divの半分3divに2V/divを掛ける必要がある。
reviews.proposedAfter: Kailangang kunin ang kalahati ng 6 div, na 3 div, at imultiply ito sa 2 V/div.
assertions: Source condition is a symmetric waveform centred at zero with6div peak-to-peak and2V/div.
Proposed Filipino halves6div to3div and multiplies by2V/div, restoring the per-division unit.
The calculation gives6V amplitude rather than12V peak-to-peak; correctIndex stays3.

reviews.canonicalText: 基本オフディレーは入力オフから設定時間後に出力オフ。電源条件や保持方式は機種資料で確認する。
reviews.before: Basic delay 4 s; check supply/retention in model.
reviews.proposedAfter: Sa karaniwang off-delay, mag-o-off ang output matapos lumipas ang itinakdang oras mula nang mag-off ang input. Suriin sa dokumentasyon ng modelo ang supply conditions at retention method.
assertions: Source off-delay timing begins at input-off; output-off follows after the4s setting.
Proposed Filipino explicitly names input-off as the starting event and output-off as the delayed event.
Power-supply conditions and retention method remain model-documentation qualifications rather than blanket operating claims.
